title: Realistic Unsupervised CLIP Fine-tuning with Universal Entropy Optimization

layout.note: Two grey rounded panels side by side. The left Train Phase panel holds a small left-to-right pipeline (class tags and prompt on top, two dashed photo sets below, two 3D encoder boxes, a similarity box and a large fine-tuning box). The right Test Phase panel holds a green circle with photos and dashed class boundaries, two outliers outside it, two goal tags with smileys and a two-row colour legend. Each panel is titled at its bottom right.

lesson: State a new learning setting as two grey panels (train, test): show the imprecise inputs as thumbnails framed by known or unknown colour, the method as a few boxes, and the test goal as a tinted circle with dashed boundaries and outliers tagged with the two goals.
